suggested_manuscript_wording.R1: R1 is an illustrative case of control-, metric- and size-dependent pairing preference. With equal-size weighting, raw hidden-state Bt/Delta are positive across all three metrics in both worlds. Joint-answer control makes aggregate CKA Bt/Delta negative in both worlds, while aggregate neighborhood-overlap and negative-error Procrustes Bt/Delta stay positive. At n10, controlled CKA Bt/Delta are positive in both worlds; at n6, controlled Procrustes Bt/Delta are negative in both. F1 and F2 are100% accurate on all identity train/validation/analysis sizes. These observations do not establish a general metric reversal or identify an internal algebraic mechanism.
suggested_manuscript_wording.R3: R3 has positive controlled CKA Delta in both worlds (0.048498 and0.121332), with dc=-0.800773/-0.755736 and du=-0.849270/-0.877068. Both correct and wrong CKA fall; the larger wrong-pair decline produces the positive increment. Do not describe this as increased correct-pair convergence. F3 remains weak at n10 even on the full training set, limiting across-size interpretation; the second-world F4 is also weak.
suggested_manuscript_wording.verification: The study has eight complete fixed20k endpoints across two independent data/initialization worlds and remains completed_with_verification_caveat, with scientific_analysis_complete=false. The original numerical audit SHA c2e799... preserves64passed/2failed/6undefined_consistent, covering only the fixed first-world R1/n6 subset of64 samples and288 selector checks. The two failures are trained raw output-probability kNN correct/wrong, each differing by1/640. Ordinary CKA, Procrustes and hidden-state kNN recorded no failures in that prescribed subset, not comprehensive verification of every production cell.
suggested_manuscript_wording.scope: No learned group representation, group multiplication, causal encoding or functionality follows from these geometry scores. Transpose/fixedmultiplication task identities can hold outside GL; two worlds repeat only this domain. Neither4relations×3sizes×3metrics nor descriptive sign counts are independent sample counts.

extra_warnings: Metric magnitudes have different scales and Procrustes is negative error; compare directions with explicit metric names, not raw cross-metric values.
Near-zero signs are descriptive, not significant or equivalent effects.
Answer-strata support differs by n and relationship; raw-versus-controlled contrast jointly changes centering and retained support, not a randomized causal subtraction of all answer information.
Output probabilities and true-answer geometry are separate baselines; hiddenDelta minus outputDelta is not an additional-mechanism estimate.
